svg.title: The blocked insert on main and with this PR
svg.desc: Left: on main the stall search picks P15, the only stall without a tray, although AGV-1 on charger C14 overlaps it; validation rejects the plan and the insert is dropped. Right: with this PR AGV-1 drives to charger C16 while AGV-2 fetches the car, and the car is parked on P15.
